ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Hilo uses the microphone to listen to you when you talk with Hilo and in calls with your family.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Hilo turns what you say into text to keep it in your book.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Hilo uses the camera to read the QR code your family gives you and to photograph documents.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: To add photos to the stories in their book. Only your family sees them.
